bodyHtml:
What This Is

Commercialized bank deposits on a distributed ledger enabling programmable, faster settlement; JPM Coin and Citi Token Services are live pilots..

Pilot deployments and early-stage commercial testing underway. Technology is proven at small scale. Our research database tracks 1 independent source on this technology.

87% of financial institutions exploring tokenization. UK Tokenized Sterling Deposits initiative (HSBC, Barclays, NatWest) running through 2026. JPM Coin and Citi Token Services live. Accenture 2026.

Status

Attribute Value
Development Stage Pilot / Limited Deployment
Confidence Level Confident
Confidence Score +0.65
Estimated Deployment 2026–2029
Horizon Near-Term (2027–2028)
Independent Sources Tracked 1

What This Enables

Advancement here directly benefits or unblocks:

  • Programmable Money

Investment Exposure

No direct listed-stock exposure identified yet in our research database.
